input.title: [Mobile] Gesture menu stucks onscreen after getting error  Swap Note
input.body:
```
- A
   - B
   - C
```


## Step to Reproduce
1. Create a Note under Thought A
2. Add text as `B`
3. Place the caret anywhere
4. Swap Note with gesture ↑←→  on mobile or Opt + Shift + N
5. Dismiss the error banner #4295

## Current behavior
Gesture menu is still onscreen.
Workaround: Close the app and reopen to dismiss the Gesture Menu

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e2c88a20-e519-4148-a32d-e6179e71a44d

## Expected behavior
Gesture menu and tracing should be auto dismissed immediately after user completes the gesture drawing
